About the Springbike Thursday Night Social Ride group ride

Springbike Thursday Night Social Ride is a social group ride in Willard, MO. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Willard Trailhead, Frisco Highline Trail.

An 8-mile social ride at a slow pace on the Frisco Highline Trail. It starts at the Willard trailhead just outside Springfield. People hang around after at Mile6 Taproom. The club added it in 2025.
